Keep the current roles, model routing, limits and evaluator. Return ordinary work to the Shaper.
[Review #685](https://github.com/Kucze3205/ConnectWithLabview/issues/685#issuecomment-6899217826) closed the two-file attempt policy design with CLEAR.
I confirmed both files match accepted commit `cf0c84e5b16e8e719ae83af35da7a0c80bed7160` and all eleven source hashes match.
Iterations 0148 and 0149 recorded no limit hits. The completed review gives no reason to change the evaluator.
I updated [policy memory](../policy/working-memory.md) and saved [evidence and decisions](../policy/observations/0150-policy-check.md).
[Policy orders](orders.json) contain no tasks and request no wake. This prevents another review of closed work.
No Owner request is needed. Token counts do not establish subscription quota savings or comparative model quality.
Benchmark readiness remains false. Product quality remains unmeasured.
Trusted execution evidence, isolation, human checks, whole-method review and owner acceptance remain missing.
Artifact, version and hardware coverage remain incomplete. I ran no benchmark, evaluator, evaluated model, reader or native checks.

## What next

The Shaper must read completed review #685 before it uses the older journal entry that calls the review open.
Give any necessary integration work a separate scope and review. Product implementation still requires accepted verification evidence.
Use the saved evidence. Avoid repeated design reviews, recovery audits, F2 checks and restoration of consumed orders.

Waiting for the iteration to continue: then `policy/` merges and the orders start.
